name: Will my current HVAC system handle an extended room?
description: It depends on your current HVAC unit's capacity; you may either extend existing ductwork, upgrade your system, or install an independent ductless unit.

mainEntity.name: Will my current HVAC system handle an extended room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extending an existing heating and cooling system depends entirely on your current HVAC equipment's tonnage and duct capacity. A room extension increases the square footage your system must condition. If your existing air handler has sufficient capacity, a contractor can tap into the trunk line and run new ductwork into the extension. If the unit is already at maximum load, upgrading the central system or installing an independent ductless mini-split system provides an efficient way to regulate temperatures without straining existing equipment.
